source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The badge text color getter uses async: callback and declares a ColorArray result. The historical change applied the same correction to browserAction, composeAction and messageDisplayAction; a string result did not describe the returned color array. An optional typed callback also lets debug schema checks validate the return value and permits callback-based callers. Check the parent implementation and callback result together. This does not require callbacks for every ordinary JavaScript function.
title: Give extension callbacks the actual result schema
